root: ^, it’s been a while. Still living as far away as possible from us, I see?
^Balbino: Life’s good away from you phonies. And you're still opening my door without knocking…
^Gunthar: Oh, I forget these formalities from your time spent with the humans. Which brings me to why I am here...
^ The Fort of Don Bas has fallen under human dominion.
^Balbino: The Fort of Don Bas? Good riddance. That place was a dump anyway.
^Gunthar: Some heroes stormed the fort like fools. Don Bas's garrison made quick work of them, and prison followed.
^Gunthar: It would seem the end of it. Only these heroes started charming the guards and half the garrison.
^ Strange talks of holidays, time off, safety insurance... even promotions based on ability.
^Balbino: Decency? Down here in the Depths? God forbid.
^Gunthar: Idealism doesn’t keep the world running. Power does. Look... I wouldn't have bothered you,
^ but Dreg is convinced you're the mad men for the job. He's probably right.
^Balbino: Didn't you hear? I don’t work for money anymore.
^Gunthar: Then name your price, my friend. Everything’s negotiable.
^Balbino: I want out of here. I thought of it for a while... It’s time for me to leave the Depths.
^ I want to drink margaritas on the beach again.
^Gunthar: Up above? You always did like to stick out like a sore thumb among humans.
^ But if that's your dying wish. I'm sure Dreg can be convinced.
^Gunthar: Come see him at his keep. Oh, and careful with the road. My cousin skeletons won't be happy to see you. And your...
^Balbino: Axe? Yes. It really rattles them... I wonder why?
^Gunthar: Don't take it personally. Half of them are here because of you.
